theorem: new plants initialize consecutive_unwatered=1 and watered_today=false
EOD increments an unwatered plant and converts consecutive_unwatered>=2 to WEED
therefore a newly established crop surviving the same EOD requires at least PLANT+WATER unit actions
BUY_LAND executes in market phase and immediately unlocks the next quadrant for later callbacks, so current empty-owned cells cannot be a hard future cap
total observed board cells is a safe physical overestimate for simultaneous surviving new plants
turnsPerDay and maxMarketOrdersPerTurn influence one-sided impossibility ceilings; explicit caller configuration cannot certify IMPOSSIBLE_ACTION_BUDGET without separate configuration custody
